source.title: Nara - Wrathful Wraith
source.name: Nara
source.description: A cold-blooded killer, lethal against those who dare to show a moment of weakness.

skills.name: Crimson Vengeance

description.raw: Nara gains 750 Energy when a battle starts. After charging up briefly, she deals 320% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based) damage to the target. If she target's HP ratio is lover than 40%, Nara deals 560% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based) true damage instead. In Auto Battle, this skill won't be used against non-boss enemy heroes whose HP ratio is above 40%.
active: Nara gains 750 Energy when a battle starts.
After charging up briefly, she deals 320% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based) damage to the target.
If she target's HP ratio is lover than 40%, Nara deals 560% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based) true damage instead.
In Auto Battle, this skill won't be used against non-boss enemy heroes whose HP ratio is above 40%.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases damage to 330% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based), and increases true damage to 570% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases damage to 340% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based), and increases true damage to 580% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 350% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based), and increases true damage to 590% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases damage to 360% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based), and increases true damage to 600% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Nara swings her axe at an enemy hero, dealing more damage to the target with lower HP ratio.

skills.name: Killer Kick

skills.name: Eerie Execution

description.raw: After defeating an enemy hero with Crimson Vengeance, Nara releases a 2-tile shockwave, dealing damage equal to 8% of the defeated target's max HP to all enemies within the area. This shockwave also heals all allies within the area by 8% of the defeated target's max HP. The damage dealth and healing from this skill cannot exceed 600% of Nara's ATK.
